hypothesis: Residualize the frozen canonical-SMILES representation against one corpus-estimated token-length axis: after otherwise unchanged prior training, estimate the direction in normalized mean-pooled recurrent space that covaries with sequence length, serialize it, and project every single-view embedding orthogonally away from that direction before final normalization.
method_thesis: Pretrain a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model and its sequence representation only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, retain a frozen prior, and restart all task-local state for each independent objective. Fit a probabilistic surrogate only to the ten fixed scored molecules and subsequent oracle-evaluated molecules, while maintaining an oracle-anchor policy updated only from returned true scores. Before each evaluator-announced batch, clone that anchor into a disposable inner policy, optimize the clone without oracle calls using the surrogate posterior mean as its molecular reward, and ancestrally sample a fresh ephemeral set of complete SMILES from the resulting policy. Canonicalize locally, remove invalid, previously evaluated, and duplicate molecules, and select the requested number by greedy batch expected improvement; after feedback, refit the surrogate, update the oracle anchor from the real observations, and discard the inner clone. Thus every submitted molecule is generated de novo, the corpus is never scored or searched as a candidate pool, and surrogate feedback changes the source distribution itself before acquisition rather than merely ranking proposals from a fixed generator. The optimization target is solely the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.

method_tags.acquisition_mechanism: greedy batch expected improvement over only fresh inner-policy samples
method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline corpus-only language-model pretraining plus online surrogate fitting, true-reward anchor updates, and oracle-free surrogate-reward inner updates
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: disposable inner-policy optimization against the surrogate posterior mean followed by ancestral de novo sampling and batch acquisition from a newly generated ephemeral set
method_tags.representation: autoregressive SMILES policy with corpus-trained sequence embeddings for a task-local probabilistic surrogate

activation_observables.measurement: After the unchanged language-model training finishes, use a deterministic 8,192-sequence subset of the corpus training split to estimate the unit direction of covariance between Parent-equivalent normalized mean-pooled recurrent embeddings and active token count. On every sequence in the existing fixed heldout corpus split, compute both the Parent-equivalent embedding and the published embedding after orthogonal projection away from that direction. Report the direction norm, the mean absolute embedding component on the learned length axis, and the absolute covariance of that component with centered token count for both representations, plus their paired projected-minus-Parent changes. Also reload the serialized state and reproduce the projected values. Activation requires a nonzero fitted length direction and a decrease in heldout mean absolute length-axis component while all embeddings remain finite and fixed-width.
activation_observables.name: embedding_length_sensitivity

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus must contain enough variation in canonical token length for normalized mean-pooled recurrent embeddings to have a finite nonzero covariance direction with token count; a zero direction invokes the unchanged bounded representation fallback and does not activate the claim.

The removed one-dimensional component must be primarily a sequence-length nuisance rather than useful molecular-size signal. Objectives whose reward strongly depends on size or whose local smoothness is aligned with that component may not benefit even when residualization activates.

The mechanism addresses only linear token-count dependence in the frozen embedding. It does not claim invariance to randomized SMILES traversals, nonlinear length effects, reward discontinuities, or chemical neighborhoods absent from the corpus-trained policy support.

The same corpus-trained GRU weights, vocabulary, BOS/EOS/padding semantics, normalized 512-dimensional output, ancestral sampler, and likelihood interface must remain usable by every unchanged downstream consumer; the learned direction is a serialized task-agnostic buffer and receives no online adaptation.

Parent n-c555e44c6daf supplies finite exact-GP assimilation but only 305 of 435 productive paired inner-policy shifts and near-zero pooled sitagliptin_mpo lift, so transfer is most plausible when weak posterior guidance is partly caused by token-length geometry rather than by the unchanged surrogate or generator mechanics.

This does not revisit the refuted checkpoint-selection attempt n-dab88c5af357, which selected the Parent terminal state on all three preparations, or graph-equivalent cluster c-9956bd4a51: it changes one corpus-estimated coordinate of each single canonical embedding without selecting another epoch, adding views, or repeating labels.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not happen if the corpus fit yields a zero or non-finite length direction, the serialized direction is not used by run-mode embeddings, any published embedding is non-finite or changes width, or the heldout mean absolute component on the learned length axis fails to decrease from the paired Parent-equivalent mean-pooled representation. A decreased length-axis component with unchanged or worse benchmark score would instead mean the mechanism activated without useful task transfer.
research_intent.implementation_change: Keep corpus reservoir sampling, split, vocabulary, GRU architecture and parameters, token likelihood objective, optimizer, five training epochs, terminal-state publication, support audit, artifact filenames, and all run-mode Layers unchanged. Add one non-parameter 512-dimensional direction buffer to the shared policy. After the Parent-identical language-model training trajectory, obtain Parent-equivalent normalized mean-pooled recurrent embeddings for a deterministic 8,192-row training subset, center token counts, form their embedding-length covariance vector, normalize it when finite and nonzero, and store it in that buffer. Change only the frozen sequence-embedding calculation to project its Parent-equivalent normalized vector orthogonally away from the stored direction and normalize again. Audit the paired Parent and projected representations on the fixed heldout split, serialize the direction in the existing state dictionary and its provenance in the existing JSON configuration, and retain an all-zero-direction fallback that exactly preserves Parent embeddings. Do not alter forward logits, likelihoods, ancestral sampling, online optimization, canonicalization, duplicate rejection, acquisition, protocol handling, or batch construction.
research_intent.mechanism: Residualize the frozen canonical-SMILES representation against one corpus-estimated token-length axis: after otherwise unchanged prior training, estimate the direction in normalized mean-pooled recurrent space that covaries with sequence length, serialize it, and project every single-view embedding orthogonally away from that direction before final normalization.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-c555e44c6daf encodes each canonical molecule by uniformly mean-pooling all non-padding recurrent states and normalizing the result, so a molecule's fixed-width GP coordinates retain an uncontrolled component associated with how many canonical tokens were averaged. The rest of the path is operational across three seeds—all 450 exact fits are positive definite and assimilate every observation—but disposable optimization improves paired surrogate reward in only 305 of 435 rounds, with pooled sitagliptin_mpo lift only 0.00011006466612005493, while macro score still varies from 0.513626533890974 to 0.575798548411393. The evidence does not establish length as the cause, making it the registered intermediate test rather than an assumed fact. A prior attempt to improve corpus support, n-dab88c5af357, selected the same terminal checkpoint on every preparation and changed neither support nor score. The graph-equivalent surrogate intervention n-f851988d522a reduced within-graph disagreement but lowered seed-0 macro by 0.15944257826084401 and weakened expected-improvement lift, so multiplying labeled views is not an adequate remedy for the Parent's representation geometry.

applicability_conditions: Activation is supported for the evaluated 250,000-record corpus reservoirs, 245,904-row training splits, 4,096-row heldout splits, five-epoch GRU training trajectory, 512-dimensional normalized mean-pooled recurrent representation, and preparation seeds 0 through 2. Each supplies enough centered active-token variation to fit a finite nonzero covariance axis from 8,192 rows.

The observed reduction transfers to heldout canonical sequences drawn by the same fixed split and tokenizer: all three replicas reduce both the mean absolute axis component and its absolute token-count covariance by many orders of magnitude while retaining finite 512-wide outputs and exact post-serialization reproduction.

Operational compatibility is supported for the unchanged downstream workflow. The serialized two-file artifacts load in all 15 objective sessions, every session reports a 512-dimensional representation, and every task completes the 300-call budget without evaluator invalid or duplicate attempts.

Useful benchmark transfer is supported only as a mixed three-seed aggregate, not as a task-universal claim. The Candidate arithmetic mean is 0.5740665499539109 versus Parent 0.5492443614715846, but seed 2 and the median_2 and zaleplon_mpo task means regress; objectives aligned with molecular size or the removed coordinate therefore remain a documented limitation.

The evidence applies to linear dependence on canonical active-token count in a single frozen canonical-SMILES view. It does not support invariance to randomized traversals, nonlinear length structure, another corpus or tokenizer, or chemical regions not represented by the corpus-trained policy.

A future preparation remains applicable only when its fitted axis is finite and nonzero and projected residuals remain finite. Exact behavior of the zero-axis fallback and numerical behavior for embeddings nearly parallel to the axis were not exercised by these replicas.

observable_measurements.parent_value: Parent n-c555e44c6daf has no length-direction buffer or projection: Parent source lines 214-223 mean-pool all non-padding recurrent states and directly L2-normalize the 512-dimensional result. The Candidate retained the Parent-identical corpus split and language-model trajectory; its seed-0 epoch NLLs and generator-support record exactly reproduce the retained Parent preparation log, and its three final NLL/support records reproduce the Parent's registered seedwise records. Candidate lines 229-235 expose that unchanged calculation as parent_equivalent_sequence_embeddings, so the parent_* fields above are paired measurements of the actual Parent-equivalent representation using the same trained weights and the same heldout rows before projection. On the learned seed-specific axes, the Parent baselines were mean absolute components 0.11110384130924397, 0.11591251430464702, and 0.11348428457550185 and absolute component/token-count covariances 1.3049886598474856, 1.373060213512991, and 1.3761585025399994 for seeds 0, 1, and 2 respectively; all baseline embeddings were finite and width 512. Parent itself serializes no learned axis, projected representation, or reload comparison, so its registered intervention effect is the unprojected side of these paired audits rather than a separate projected value.
observable_measurements.value: Each of the three preparations fit the registered axis from exactly 8,192 training sequences and audited all 4,096 sequences in its fixed heldout split. The receipt logs the nonzero pre-normalization embedding/token-count covariance-vector norm, while Candidate source normalizes that vector before storing and applying it. Seed 0 recorded norm 1.311976377385533 with direction_was_fitted true; its heldout mean absolute component fell from the paired Parent-equivalent 0.11110384130924397 to 4.907165000922876e-09, a projected-minus-Parent change of -0.11110383640207896, and absolute component/token-count covariance fell from 1.3049886598474856 to 1.125383884965487e-09, a change of -1.3049886587221018. Seed 1 recorded norm 1.3856595981543012 with direction_was_fitted true; mean absolute component fell from 0.11591251430464702 to 5.0845429957540145e-09, change -0.11591250922010403, and absolute covariance fell from 1.373060213512991 to 6.679349496332276e-10, change -1.373060212845056. Seed 2 recorded norm 1.3682322915069671 with direction_was_fitted true; mean absolute component fell from 0.11348428457550185 to 4.868809425772047e-09, change -0.11348427970669242, and absolute covariance fell from 1.3761585025399994 to 7.371612665496392e-10, change -1.3761585018028382. Every receipt reports finite Parent-equivalent and projected embeddings, Parent and projected widths of 512, serialized_reload_max_absolute_embedding_difference 0.0, and serialized_reload_exact true. Thus the registered component and covariance both decreased on every replica, while serialization and the frozen-width interface held exactly.

possible_failure_causes: The near-zero post-projection component is a direct algebraic consequence of projecting orthogonally to the fitted axis. It confirms that the registered code path executed, but by itself does not establish that the removed coordinate was nuisance rather than useful molecular-size or chemical signal.

Benchmark transfer is favorable in aggregate but not uniform. Candidate val_scores 0.57967531757739, 0.572758745855755, and 0.569765586428588 compare with paired Parent values 0.513626533890974, 0.558308002112387, and 0.575798548411393, giving seedwise changes 0.06604878368641598, 0.014450743743368077, and -0.006032961982805007 and a three-seed mean change 0.02482218848232635. Task-mean changes are positive on deco_hop, drd2_docking, and sitagliptin_mpo but negative on median_2 (-0.012321768011749399) and zaleplon_mpo (-0.03560844421410928). This mixed evidence is consistent with the removed coordinate sometimes carrying objective-relevant size information, although the evaluations do not isolate that explanation.

The fit uses one deterministic 8,192-row prefix of each seed-specific shuffled training split. All three observed covariance norms are nonzero, but a corpus, ordering, tokenizer, or preparation seed with less length variation or a materially different covariance direction could weaken or eliminate activation.

Only one linear coordinate associated with centered canonical token count is removed. Nonlinear length effects, alternative SMILES traversals, syntax sensitivity, reward discontinuities, and unsupported chemical neighborhoods remain outside the mechanism and can still limit surrogate geometry.

For an unseen sequence whose Parent-equivalent embedding is almost parallel to the learned direction, the residual before final normalization can be very small and numerically unstable. Every audited heldout embedding was finite, but the receipt does not report a minimum residual norm or establish this property outside the observed corpus and downstream samples.

The all-zero-direction fallback was not exercised in any replica because every fitted norm exceeded the finite-nonzero threshold. Source provides the bounded fallback, but these logs do not empirically establish its claimed exact Parent preservation under a zero-axis corpus.

Exact reload and successful downstream sessions establish serialization and interface compatibility, not that the modified embedding improves GP calibration, local chemical neighborhood stability, or every disposable inner-policy update. Those are distinct observables owned by later Layers.
